1.title: Email and Outlook
1.content:
- Outlook keeps asking for a password: sign out of Office apps, clear saved credentials in Windows Credential Manager, then sign in again (MFA prompt expected).
- Mailbox full: archive old mail with the Online Archive, empty Deleted Items, and remove large attachments.
- Shared mailbox missing: shared mailboxes appear automatically about an hour after access is granted. Restart Outlook.
- Calendar not syncing on phone: remove and re-add the account in the Outlook mobile app.
- Sending large files: share a link from the file share or OneDrive instead of attaching files larger than 20 MB.

2.title: Network file shares (Samba)
2.content:
| Share | Path | Who has access |
|---|---|---|
| Public | \\fileserver\Public | All staff, read/write |
| Finance | \\fileserver\Finance | Finance team only |
| Scans | \\fileserver\Scans | Staff who use the scanner; scans land here |

3.title: Network file shares (Samba)
3.content:
1. Open File Explorer, right-click "This PC", choose "Map network drive".
2. Pick a letter (e.g. P:) and enter \\fileserver\Public.
3. Tick "Reconnect at sign-in" and "Connect using different credentials". Use your lab username and password.
When working remotely, connect the VPN first.

4.title: Network file shares (Samba)
4.content:
- "Access is denied" on Finance: access is group-based. Ask your manager to approve, then raise an Access ticket.
- "The network path was not found": you are off-site without the VPN, or the server name did not resolve. Try the IP address from the IT intranet.
- Saved the wrong version of a file: shadow copies are taken nightly. IT can restore from the last 14 days; include the full path and approximate time.
- Do not store personal data or passwords in Public. Use Finance or ask IT for a restricted folder.

5.title: Staff onboarding and offboarding
5.content:
- Manager raises an Onboarding ticket at least 3 business days before the start date with name, role, start date and the shares needed.
- IT creates the account, enrols MFA on day one, assigns a laptop with the standard build, and adds the user to the right file-share groups.
- VPN access is issued only for roles that work remotely.
- First-day pack: Wi-Fi details, printer setup guide, how to raise a ticket.

6.title: Staff onboarding and offboarding
6.content:
- Manager raises an Offboarding ticket with the last working day.
- On the last day IT disables the account, revokes VPN peers, removes share access, and collects devices.
- Mail is forwarded to the manager for 30 days if requested.

7.title: Passwords and multi-factor authentication (MFA)
7.content:
1. Go to the self-service reset portal from the sign-in page and click "Forgot password".
2. Verify with your registered authenticator app or mobile number.
3. Choose a passphrase of at least 14 characters. Do not reuse old passwords.
IT staff will never ask for your password by email, chat or phone.

8.title: Passwords and multi-factor authentication (MFA)
8.content: Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again carefully. Phones with an old saved password often cause repeat lockouts; update the password in mail apps.

9.title: Passwords and multi-factor authentication (MFA)
9.content: Raise an Access ticket. IT will verify your identity on a video call before resetting MFA. A lost phone is a security issue; mention it so IT can sign out other sessions.

10.title: Passwords and multi-factor authentication (MFA)
10.section: Suspicious email asking for your password
10.content: Do not click. Use "Report phishing" in Outlook or forward it to IT, then delete it. If you already entered your password, change it immediately and raise a P1 Security ticket.

11.title: Printing (CUPS print server)
11.content:
- Windows: Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners > Add device. If it is not found, choose "Add manually" and enter http://printserver:631/printers/Office-Laser.
- macOS: System Settings > Printers & Scanners > Add, choose the IP tab, protocol IPP, address printserver, queue printers/Office-Laser.
- A PDF printer (queue "Office-PDF") is also available for testing and for saving print jobs as PDFs to the Scans share.

12.title: Printing (CUPS print server)
12.content:
1. Job stuck in the queue: open http://printserver:631/jobs, cancel your job, then print again.
2. "Printer offline": check the printer has power and paper and the screen shows no error. Restart it once.
3. Prints blank or garbled: remove and re-add the printer to refresh the driver (use the generic PCL or IPP Everywhere driver).
4. Printing from home: connect to the VPN first.
If several people cannot print at once, raise a P2 ticket; it is probably the print server, not your PC.

13.title: Service desk policy and SLAs
13.content:
| Priority | Meaning | First response | Resolution target |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | Business down or security incident (outage, compromised account, lost device) | 15 minutes | 4 hours |
| P2 | Team or service degraded (printer down for many, VPN failing for several users) | 1 hour | 1 business day |
| P3 | Single user issue with a workaround | 4 hours | 3 business days |
| P4 | Request or question (access, how-to, new software) | 1 business day | 5 business days |

14.title: Service desk policy and SLAs
14.content: The AI copilot drafts answers from this knowledge base only. Replies are sent automatically only for low-risk P3/P4 questions where the copilot is confident and an independent check agrees the answer is fully supported by the knowledge base. Security incidents, access changes, P1/P2 issues, and any ticket containing personal or sensitive information always go to a human.

15.title: Remote access VPN (WireGuard)
15.content: All staff who work from home or travel. Contractors need manager approval first (raise a ticket with category "Access").

16.title: Remote access VPN (WireGuard)
16.content:
1. Install the WireGuard app (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android) from the official store or wireguard.com.
2. IT sends you a personal config file or QR code from the VPN admin console (wg-easy). Never share it; each config is tied to one device.
3. Import the file (or scan the QR code) and toggle the tunnel on.
4. Test by opening the file share \\fileserver\Public or the printer page http://printserver:631.

17.title: Remote access VPN (WireGuard)
17.content:
- Tunnel shows "active" but nothing loads: check the "Latest handshake" time. If it never updates, your network may block UDP 51820 (hotel or guest Wi-Fi). Try a phone hotspot.
- Handshake works but shares do not open: you are probably using a stale config after a device rebuild. Ask IT to revoke the old peer and issue a new one.
- Slow speeds: disconnect from other VPNs; only one tunnel can be active.
- Lost or stolen device: raise a P1 ticket immediately so IT can revoke that device's peer key.

18.title: Office Wi-Fi and network
18.content:
- Staff network: "Office-Staff" (WPA2-Enterprise, sign in with your work account).
- Guest network: "Office-Guest". Password is displayed at reception and changes monthly. Guests cannot reach file shares or printers.
- Cannot connect: forget the network and reconnect; check the date and time on your device; restart Wi-Fi.
- Internet is slow for everyone: raise a P2 ticket. If it is only you, move closer to the access point and close large uploads or syncs.
- Never plug personal routers or switches into office wall ports.
